name: GQA
description: A visual question answering dataset built from real-world images and scene graphs, designed to support compositional reasoning and balanced question-answer distributions.
citation: Hudson, D. A., & Manning, C. D. (2019). GQA: A new dataset for real-world visual reasoning and compositional question answering. Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR), 6700–6709. https://doi.org/10.1109/CVPR.2019.00686
